summary: Taiwan manufacturing momentum remains strong and U.S. activity is still expansionary, but the global-risk overlay deteriorated further on September 7. Brent and WTI rose to about $97.47 and $92.26 per barrel, a reported attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery added refinery-supply risk, Hormuz commodity-ship traffic remained near its lowest since May, and a separate bunker-fuel squeeze is now materially raising the risk of higher Asian freight and imported inflation. No newer official CPI/PCE/NFP/PMI/Taiwan-export release superseded the existing macro observations in this run.

geopolitical_global_risk.summary: The Middle East shock broadened from crude-oil and tanker disruption into refinery and bunker-fuel scarcity. Reuters reported Brent near $97.47 and WTI near $92.26, a reported attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, and Hormuz traffic averaging about 10 commodity ships per day over the prior 10 days. Separately, Singapore very-low-sulphur fuel oil was reported up about 76% since the Iran war began, with Middle East fuel-oil exports down 45% year on year in March-August and a third-quarter deficit forecast. This makes higher freight/import-cost transmission to Taiwan more immediate.

key_risks: Strait of Hormuz disruption and renewed U.S.-Iran attacks remain a high-severity energy/shipping shock.
A reported attack on the Jazan refinery broadens the risk from shipping disruption into refinery infrastructure.
Bunker-fuel scarcity in Asia can lift freight costs and imported inflation even if crude prices stabilize.
U.S. August PPI is due on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11, so energy and freight shocks are especially relevant to rate expectations.
The FOMC meets on 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-16 with a Summary of Economic Projections.
Russia-Ukraine refinery disruptions remain a persistent refined-product risk, although renewed diplomacy modestly lowers near-term escalation probability.
U.S.-China semiconductor tariffs/export-control policy remains a structural market-access and capex-geography risk for Taiwan technology companies.
